notes: Reports the script process identity and selected OS protection information. Does not enable Windows token privileges or reproduce all built-in protection checks.

commands.linux:
# Standalone example: Reports the script process identity and selected OS protection information. Does not enable Windows token privileges or reproduce all built-in protection checks.
set -e
id
cat /proc/self/status
commands.darwin:
# Standalone example: Reports the script process identity and selected OS protection information. Does not enable Windows token privileges or reproduce all built-in protection checks.
set -e
id
csrutil status
profiles status -type enrollment
commands.windows:
# Standalone example: Reports the script process identity and selected OS protection information. Does not enable Windows token privileges or reproduce all built-in protection checks.
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
whoami /all
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "whoami failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
